BrochureContent.Content:
A 4 Bedroom detached residence which sits on 0.32 acre site, located in the peaceful and rural setting of Killour, The Neale, Ballinrobe, Co. Mayo. Conveniently located just 4 km from Ballinrobe, 8km from Clonbur and Cong, this property enjoys a superb location, close to one of Ireland’s most  sought-after destinations. Nestled between Lough Corrib and Lough Mask, the property is well located and close to a range of outdoor pursuits including golf, fishing, boating and scenic woodland walks.

The residence is presented in poor condition and requires renovation internally, presenting an excellent opportunity for redevelopment and modernisation.  

The property has a mix of double-glazed aluminium and single-glazed timber windows, with PVC front and back doors. To the rear of the property there is a large 2-bay hay shed with lean-to.

The accommodation includes Entrance Hallway, Kitchen/Living Room, Sitting Room, Back Kitchen, Bathroom, 4 Bedrooms. 

The property offers significant potential for those seeking a renovation project. 

Full particulars from sole selling agents.
